boundary: Unique scientific_document_attempt cache keys in v4 local workspaces; copied recovery workspaces deduplicated. Standalone comparison diagnostics are separately listed, not added to service totals. Historical v3 campaign is not repeated or added. Usage unknown is not zero billing. Operational errors and model/source validation rejections are distinct.
limitations: Hosted alias is recorded; exact provider weight/version is not exposed.
Reasoning-only EOF may be recorded as JSONDecodeError rather than transport EOF; empty content never becomes science.
No account-specific dollar cost, unlimited quota or production license is established.
Validated partial prefixes persist and are independently rechecked; a completion does not establish scientific correctness.
